# Tech Weekly Releases

> Short videos built from official sources. Every number is quoted from an official page (linked on each page); computations are shown as arithmetic. Narration uses an AI voice.

## Policies

- [How we verify](https://d0nd1.github.io/signalforge-data/tech-weekly-releases/how-we-verify.html)
- [Corrections](https://d0nd1.github.io/signalforge-data/tech-weekly-releases/corrections.html)
- [Disclosure](https://d0nd1.github.io/signalforge-data/tech-weekly-releases/disclosure.html)
